summary.name: CleanClip
summary.one_liner: CleanClip is a macOS clipboard manager that keeps copy history and lets you search and paste past items at the text cursor using ⌘+; and number keys.
use_cases: Find and reuse previously copied text or images
Paste a sequence of items in order into forms
Collect snippets from multiple pages and paste together
Search past command-line commands like ffmpeg
summary.what_it_does: CleanClip automatically saves copied content and shows a popup at the text input position, opened with ⌘+; and paste by pressing 0-9. It keeps a history that starts with the latest 5 records and expands to 10 per page, with search appearing when typing begins. Paste Stack queues copied items so ⌘V pastes them in order, and ⌘⇧C Split Copy breaks multiple lines into separate items. Users can create unlimited bookmark lists, smart lists with conditional filters, and per-app collections, and can pin a main window that follows the frontmost app.
notable: Popup appears near the text input cursor, avoiding window switching
Paste Stack pastes queued items in sequence with ⌘V
Unlimited bookmark lists, smart lists, and follow-frontmost-app view
Localized into many languages including English, Chinese, French, German, Japanese and Arabic
caveats: Mac only; no Windows, Linux or iOS version is mentioned
Listed as Freeware on awesome-mac, but the page itself does not state a price
